stages.details: Explicit stakeholder, dependencies, security and N/A dimensions added; status:ready verified. One active item (#233), below WIP cap 3.

findings: External label, setting and runner acceptance criteria were deferred until after merge, creating a circular dependency because Done must pass before merge.

Deleting canonical lifecycle labels conflicts with the current requirement for one status per open issue and post-merge status:done unless the explicit owner-authorized retirement exception is recorded.

corrections.requestedChanges: Sequence external cleanup after exact-head checks and owner PR review/approval as a required pre-merge integration gate; reconcile issue, plan, inventory, PR and run evidence.

Record the owner-authorized one-time retirement of canonical/legacy statuses; snapshot all assignments, disable routing before catalogue deletion, preserve other issue content/states/labels, do not recreate statuses, and close #296 by issue state after merge without status:done.
checks: Live read-only open-issue assignment snapshot: 48 open, 45 carrying lifecycle status

constraints: No implementation before independent plan approval.
Owner retains all Definition of Done judgement dimensions; no merge authorized in this executor task.
Repository label catalogue, activation settings and idle exclusive runner retirement require exact-head checks and owner PR review/approval, then live verification before Done and merge.
No new Lighthouse install, credential action, production deployment or shared infrastructure deletion.

retirementException.authority: Owner explicitly requested removing all AI/SDLC artifacts and labels from this repository before a later clean Lighthouse install.
retirementException.appliesAt: Approved pre-merge retirement gate after exact-head checks, owner PR review/approval, assignment snapshot and disabled Lighthouse activations.
retirementException.openIssuesAfterRetirement: Preserve GitHub open/closed state, bodies/comments and retained labels; no lifecycle status until separately authorized installation.
retirementException.issue296Completion: Close GitHub issue after confirmed merge without status:done.
